colorMeta.format: hex retained: owner spec is the normative source

typographyMeta.wordmark: Alfa Slab One (OFL) — wide heavy slab, the closest free match to the IBM-derived Maniac/Neberdine logo
typographyMeta.body: Inter (owner-pinned; on the reflex-reject list, 1 hit < 3 threshold)
typographyMeta.mono: JetBrains Mono (owner-pinned, already in the project)
typographyMeta.hosting: self-host via @fontsource packages in Astro; Google Fonts acceptable for static prototypes

motion.registerRationale: PRODUCT.md personality: reading-first personal publication; theatrics stay in static marks, not movement

stripeMask.rule: horizontal bars cut through the wordmark; bar height ≈ 1/9 of cap height, gap equal; applied by CSS mask so text remains selectable and readable by assistive tech

chamferedCorner.rule: one clipped corner (12–16px) on cards and masthead only

subjectBadge.rule: navy tag, label caps, numbers derived from real post order and dates only

buttons.secondary: 1px navy outline, cream fill on hover

inputs.style: bottom rule only; thickens to ice blue on focus

header.purpose: wordmark lockup + plain nav (Home, Posts, Micros, Archive, About) + search + theme switch

footer.purpose: owner copyright, RSS, sitemap, social links; no theme credit

identity-intro.purpose: who Khalil is, first on the home page
identity-intro.constraint: owner copy only; placeholder for anything not yet written

subject-file.purpose: post header: title, badge row (ordinal, date, category), tags

iaPriorities.evidence: owner answer: homepage leads with 'Who I am, then posts'

do: Corporate form labels as eyebrows: 'Subject file', 'Intake', 'Trial log', 'Records'
Plain nav labels: Home, Posts, Micros, Archive, About
Keep the owner's casual voice in all body copy
dont: Invent bio, titles, employers or stats
Rename the owner's own headings or post titles

divergence.modeReason: owner pinned a new palette and type (midnight-editorial.md) and named the captured surface (stock Fuwari) as the thing to replace; captured signal is a theme default, not the owner's brand

font_deck.name: owner-specified + wordmark
font_deck.picked_by: user-constraint (Source Serif 4 / Inter / JetBrains Mono); reasoned: Maniac logo (Alfa Slab One)

anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Owner explicitly asked for 'a softer cream color' instead of white. (#F5F5DC also misses the deterministic test: HSL S≈56% > 40%.)
Owner spec assigns JetBrains Mono to dates, reading time and tags; it also stands in for the CRT terminal text of Maniac's GRTA computer room.
Maniac's key art shows numbered test-subject badges (1 and 9); the badge is the show's most recognizable prop. Bounded: post headers and cards only, numbers derived from real content.
The owner's reference is a fictional pharma trial company; the register is the point. Bounded to eyebrow labels; nav labels and prose stay plain.

anti_toolbox_hits.move: Dark mode editorial (dark ground + cream text)
anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Ground is Penn State Blue, the owner's alma mater color he asked for, not ink black; dark mode is the existing site's feature.

off_toolbox_moves.move: Striped slab wordmark via CSS mask
off_toolbox_moves.basis: Maniac's logo is literally the IBM striped treatment; applied to MANNS it becomes his mark

off_toolbox_moves.move: Backlit panels lighter than the ground
off_toolbox_moves.basis: Maniac's lab walls are backlit white panels; inverts the usual 'cards darker/shadowed' depth
the lab's angled/hexagonal wall panels in the Netflix still

removed.reason: impeccable absolute ban; replaced with a solid cream header
not needed for a reading site; avoids the SaaS silhouette

owner_pinned_inversions.why: owner spec is the normative source

owner_pinned_inversions.kept: 4px left rule on blockquotes and admonitions

audit_adjustments.reason: a numbered badge is a serial stamp whatever the source; kept with justification and a real-data rule

narrative.northStar: The front office of a 1980s tech company whose only product is Khalil Manns.
narrative.overview: Cream paper and Penn State navy; a striped slab wordmark; numbered subject badges and corporate form labels; calm editorial reading inside posts.
rules: No shadows, glass, neon or gradients
Theatrics never enter post body text
